resources.string: Locus Earth 是一个网页应用，这里的界面由网页实时加载，与使用浏览器打开的是同一份。它不是原生 App：功能更新随网页自动生效，无需更新安装包。需要联网使用。原网页：locus-earth.pages.dev。

Locus Earth is a web app, and its interface is loaded in real-time through the web, just like when you open it in a browser. It’s not a native app: feature updates take effect automatically whenever the web page updates, so there’s no need to update the installation package. It requires an internet connection. Original web page: locus-earth.pages.dev.
